name: Taskora
description: Taskora - A modern task and project management app that helps you organize work efficiently. Create projects, manage tasks, set deadlines, and track progress with an intuitive interface.

paragraphs: Taskora is a modern, intuitive web application designed to streamline task and project management. It allows users to efficiently create projects, assign tasks, set deadlines, and monitor progress with ease.
